decisions.subject: portrait_medium
decisions.instruction: For a Roman bronze bust, preserve modeled portrait specificity, metallic depth, cast-and-finished surface behavior, and any inlay logic supported by the chosen example/context.

decisions.subject: bronze_detail
decisions.instruction: If visible and appropriate, use restrained contrasting metal/stone inlays to support lifelike eyes or details; do not turn them into fantasy glow.

decisions.subject: hairstyle
decisions.instruction: Use a date-sensitive Roman coiffure tied to the selected century/reign; if the date is broad, keep hair restrained and avoid overclaiming specificity.
